description: Generates a new secp256k1 eth proof-owner key and writes the private key to the project `.env` as RECLAIM_PRIVATE_KEY (mode 0600; `.env` added to .gitignore). Returns the address and the `.env` path; never the key. The key is a local signing key only: it is not registered with any server and is unrelated to org auth or encryption. Confirm with the developer before replacing an existing key. `run_proof` then picks it up through `resolve_owner_key`.

projectDir.description: Project directory whose `.env` the key is written to. Defaults to the closest ancestor of cwd containing .git or package.json.

name: issue_credentials
